newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products easier apart from naphtha.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products easier apart from naphtha.

text.p: NWE oil products were weaker on Friday, with the execption of naphtha . Gasoline barges eased back. A single trader sold Eurograde barges between $201 and $198.25 fob ARA.
Naphtha held its strength as traders bid hard on swaps markets. Physical prices are above those of gasoline.
Gas oil eased on futures and softer premiums as the arrival of north American gas oil in Europe drew closer.
High sulphur barges toyed around $113-114 fob ARA, about $1 off yesterday's levels in quiet trading. Tight supply fundamentals underpinned the market. -- London +44 171 542 8980
